title: SchemaEntityKindsResponse
description: Response from maz schema entity-kinds: an array of entity kind taxonomy rows joined to live counts.

items.description: One entity kind taxonomy entry with its live entity count.

provenance.description: Namespace lane: core (built-in), user (manually added), or extension:<name> (plugin-contributed).

extends.description: Parent kind in the subtype hierarchy. Empty string for root kinds.

sameAs.description: External ontology URIs this kind maps to, e.g. ["https://schema.org/Person"].

count.description: Number of entities of this kind currently in the store.

addedAt.description: Time the kind was registered. RFC 3339 UTC.

addedBy.description: Who added the kind: seed, llm, user, or extension.
